title: SkillMatch
problem: Hiring platforms match keywords, not capability and context.
approach: Built the AI matching backend around AWS Bedrock Titan embeddings, CockroachDB vector search, and secure S3 presigned resume uploads. Refactored route registration and resolved data-model failures during the build.
outcome: Delivered the core matching and infrastructure path for a working hackathon product.

title: Business OS
problem: Small businesses juggle disconnected tools for inventory, sales, and records.
approach: Designed a modular Go/Gin backend with PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, and Dockerized local infrastructure for a Next.js client.
outcome: Established a maintainable service foundation for a chat-first SME operating system.

title: African Vault
problem: Kenyan SACCOs and chamas need member, contribution, loan, and payment tools shaped around local workflows.
approach: Built the banking core in Go with GORM and SQLite, including transaction flows, statements, M-Pesa STK Push, and Africa's Talking SMS integration. The product is now being repositioned as a Digital SACCO Management System.
outcome: Created a locally relevant financial platform with payment and communication rails already integrated.

title: CashFlowGuardian
problem: Freelancers lose revenue when scope changes go undocumented and unbilled.
approach: Built a multi-agent workflow using the Strands Agents SDK and AWS Bedrock to detect scope creep, surface evidence, and prepare invoice-ready recommendations.
outcome: Shipped a human-centered agent prototype for AWS's Agents for Humans hackathon.

title: Guidely
problem: A RAG application had a leaked key, silent embedding failures, and unreliable graded behavior.
approach: Audited the Python/FastAPI codebase, removed the exposed secret, traced silent failures, migrated OpenAI integrations to Gemini, and repaired the retrieval pipeline.
outcome: Reached 100% across all graded metrics after resolving eight production issues.
